qualification: Verified exact scan one-shot cancellation across every observed checkpoint of a stable two-group fixture
method: Run a successful verified scan and count every cancellation callback invocation.
Replay the scan once per observed callback position, returning true only at that position.
Every replay must be cancelled, incomplete and publish zero groups.
An uncancelled retry must preserve both baseline groups.
platform: Linux 6.8 aarch64 / Rust 1.98 / UID 1000 / private tmpfs; native exact source standalone wrapper
limits: This qualifies the observed healthy fixture trace, not every filesystem error branch or decoder cancellation latency.
Full-library suite was not repeated for this test-only addition.
No atomic snapshot or allocator/RSS bound claim.
